# Nabaperks

> Nabaperks is a browser-based loyalty service for UK food and drink venues. Customers use a venue QR code to open a loyalty card, collect venue-linked stamps and redeem rewards without installing an app. Nabaperks is operated by Lapen Inns, a hospitality operator running 9 pubs across England, and is sold as a done-for-you launch plus a Growth Plan subscription.

## Service facts

- Each stamp claim is linked to the venue QR, saved membership and live programme, with one claim per customer per UK date.
- Optional location checks can flag unusual claims.
- Loyalty participation and marketing consent are separate.
- Nabaperks is operated by Lapen Inns.
- Public contact and privacy contact: info@lapeninns.com.

## Offer facts

- Primary market: single-site, owner-operated UK food-led pubs with busy weekends and quiet Tuesday–Thursday trade.
- Offer name: "The 30-Day Gastropub Mid-Week Revenue Accelerator" — the offer's name, not a revenue promise.
- Delivery: done-for-you launch by Lapen Inns (venue and card configured, 5-stamp food-led cycle, margin-safe mystery reward pool, birthday automation, Bring-a-Regular referral loop, first A4 counter-poster run printed and posted).
- Pricing: £99 one-off setup invoiced at onboarding (not charged through online checkout), then £49/month or £490/year (2 months free) after a 30-day free pilot (card required). Cancel anytime from the billing page.
- Guarantees: First-Regular Guarantee (the pilot stays free until a first regular returns) and the 90-Day ROI Extension (if verified return visits have not covered the software cost by day 90, the next 3 months are free). Nabaperks does not guarantee midweek revenue or filled tables.
- Capacity: a maximum of 5 done-for-you onboardings per week — real human capacity, no invented counters.
